questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase.

A. On the table, the book lay.
B. Never have I seen such a beautiful garden.
C. So fast did he run that he broke the record.
D. It was not until she arrived that the meeting started.
options: On the table, the book lay.
Never have I seen such a beautiful garden.
So fast did he run that he broke the record.
It was not until she arrived that the meeting started.
questions.answer: It was not until she arrived that the meeting started.

questions.question:
Which of the following sentences correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail about the event?

A. It was yesterday that they visited the museum.
B. Yesterday they visited the museum.
C. They visited the museum yesterday.
D. The museum was visited by them yesterday.
options: It was yesterday that they visited the museum.
Yesterday they visited the museum.
They visited the museum yesterday.
The museum was visited by them yesterday.
questions.answer: It was yesterday that they visited the museum.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly uses the third type of conditional sentence to express an unreal situation in the past.

A. If I had known the time, I would have arrived earlier.
B. If I had studied harder, I might have passed the exam.
C. If I were you, I would take that job.
D. If I had been aware of the consequences, I would have acted differently.
options: If I had known the time, I would have arrived earlier.
If I had studied harder, I might have passed the exam.
If I were you, I would take that job.
If I had been aware of the consequences, I would have acted differently.
questions.answer: If I had been aware of the consequences, I would have acted differently.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation or requirement?

A. I suggest that he leaves immediately.
B. It is recommended that he leaves immediately.
C. He is recommended to leave immediately.
D. That he leaves immediately is recommended.
options: I suggest that he leaves immediately.
It is recommended that he leaves immediately.
He is recommended to leave immediately.
That he leaves immediately is recommended.
questions.answer: It is recommended that he leaves immediately.

questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly demonstrates ellipsis, where a word is omitted but understood from context.

A. She likes coffee, and he tea.
B. She likes coffee, and he does too.
C. She likes coffee, and he likes it too.
D. She likes coffee, and he likes the same.
options: She likes coffee, and he tea.
She likes coffee, and he does too.
She likes coffee, and he likes it too.
She likes coffee, and he likes the same.
questions.answer: She likes coffee, and he does too.
